passage:
council — 议会；市政委员会
Last month, the town council showed two plans.

crossings — 人行横道；过街处
Workers will put three new zebra crossings near the school and the market.

speed limit — 限速
The speed limit will go down from 30 mph to 20 mph.

lane — 车道
The council will move the bus stops to the middle of the high street and make one new bus lane.

parking — 停车；停车位
However, Plan B has fewer parking spaces than Plan A.

customers — 顾客
They say, 'Our customers come by car.

popular — 受欢迎的
The most popular plan will start in September.

quickest — 最快的（最高级）
Plan A is the cheapest, and Plan B is the quickest for buses.
